overview: Dawnshroud Peaks is a rugged volcanic region on Luclin’s surface. Its mesas and ridges are home to rockhoppers, Grimlings, and deep tunnel networks.
history: The Peaks formed from ancient volcanic activity. During the Terror of Luclin era, Grimling incursions intensified and rockhopper migrations became more aggressive.
hooks: Rockhopper migrations surge across the mesas.
Nether tunnels reveal new volcanic chambers.
Twilight ridges pulse with strange arcane energy.
A caravan disappears near the Great Divide Pass.
